description: This file provides implementation for handling git bundle commands, including creating, verifying, listing heads, and unbundling bundle files. It interacts with repository structures, parses options, and manages bundle headers.

methods.name: int cmd_bundle_verify(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

methods.name: int cmd_bundle_list_heads(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

methods.name: int cmd_bundle_unbundle(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
